title: RPGs
description: Your destination for role-playing game coverage. From epic open-world adventures to tactical turn-based classics, we bring you in-depth reviews, expert guides, and the stories behind the stories.

timeline.title: Metaphor outsells every Atlus game in history
timeline.author: Ali Jones
timeline.quote: I predicted this would happen in my review 6 months ago. Metaphor isn't just a great RPG — it's proof that turn-based games can go mainstream when the writing is this sharp.

timeline.title: Tactics Dawn: The indie RPG breakout
timeline.author: Jordan Gerblick
timeline.quote: Nobody saw this coming. A three-person studio shipped a tactics game that out-paced every AAA RPG release this summer. This is what passion projects look like.

timeline.title: Hades II leaves early access
timeline.author: Anthony McGlynn
timeline.quote: Supergiant didn't just iterate — they reinvented. Hades II is a masterclass in understanding what made the original special and then doubling down on all of it.

timeline.title: The Nightreign difficulty debate
timeline.author: Josh West
timeline.quote: The discourse around difficulty in RPGs has never been louder. Nightreign forces us to ask: is a game truly accessible if its hardest content is locked behind skill walls?

timeline.title: Our 2025 RPG predictions
timeline.author: Josh West
timeline.quote: We called 7 out of 10 correctly. The ones we missed? Nobody could have predicted the Persona resurgence or the Starfield DLC receiving this level of critical praise.

editorialStances.quote: Turn-based combat isn't just nostalgic — it's outpacing action RPGs
editorialStances.body: Recent data shows completion rates for turn-based games are up 34% compared to action-heavy releases. The deliberate pacing allows for complex systems to breathe.

comments.text: Absolutely agree. I can pause turn-based whenever, and it respects my time.
Strongly disagree, nothing beats real-time skill expression.

editorialStances.quote: Shorter, focused RPG campaigns are inherently superior to 100-hour slogs
editorialStances.body: We are seeing massive drops in player retention after hour 30. Designing games to fit realistic adult schedules is a mark of true narrative discipline.

comments.text: A great RPG should respect a player's time without losing its sense of scale.
Give me a memorable 100 hours over a rushed 20 every time.

hotTakes.quote: Turn-based combat is objectively superior to real-time action in RPGs.
Open worlds have become a crutch for developers who can't write good stories.

questions.title: A huge open world or a focused adventure?
